summary: Learn to plan interoperable public services, assess DPI safeguards, and shape procurement requirements. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Digital public infrastructure training helps public-service teams plan shared identity, payment and data-exchange foundations. For government digital-transformation teams and public-service product owners, it builds practical skills to map dependencies, assess inclusion and privacy risks, draft interoperability and procurement requirements, and shape accountable governance and implementation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners shaping shared digital foundations, service delivery, policy, and procurement across public institutions and development programmes.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: Experience in public-service delivery, digital transformation, technology governance, privacy, procurement, or development-programme work will help you apply the course scenarios. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop for digital architecture-mapping exercises; diagrams.net can be accessed without a commercial licence.
